title: Constructibility of localizing exceptional cohomology
statement: Fix a universe u, a prime \ell, a field k of characteristic different from \ell, separated finite-type schemes Z and Y over k, a proper morphism g : Z -> Y, and an admissible ell-adic coefficient Lambda, as in [lem-sfb-adic-localizing-exceptional-constructible]. For every supplied adjunction adj : ellAdicLocalizingLowerStar Lambda ell g hLambda \dashv G and every K in the bounded constructible subcategory of Y, every homology object of the underlying object G(K) is a constructible module object over the coefficient ring on Z.

lean.statement: theorem ellAdic_localizing_rightAdjoint_obj_homology_constructible (G : (boundedConstructibleLocalizingClosure Λ Y.left).FullSubcategory ⥤ (boundedConstructibleLocalizingClosure Λ Z.left).FullSubcategory) (adj : ellAdicLocalizingLowerStar Λ ℓ g hΛ ⊣ G) (K : (boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ Y.left)).FullSubcategory) : ∀ n : ℤ, IsConstructibleModuleObject (condensedRingObj Λ Z.left) ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj ((G.obj ((boundedConstructibleToLocalizing Λ Y.left).obj K)).obj))

proof.text: The coefficient comparison and local smooth and closed restriction calculations give constructibility in every homological degree; finite affine descent and right-adjoint uniqueness transfer this to the supplied functor.
